Class PropertiesSslBundle

java.lang.Object
org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.ssl.PropertiesSslBundle
All Implemented Interfaces:
SslBundle
public final class PropertiesSslBundle extends Object implements SslBundle
由 SslBundle 支持，该接口由 JksSslBundleProperties 或 PemSslBundleProperties 实现。
